level.theme: Eerie, foreboding, and claustrophobic, with flickering lights, distorted sounds, and a sense of being constantly watched.
level.setting: A decaying alchemical laboratory buried beneath the earth, filled with shifting shadows, ghostly echoes, and cursed relics of ancient experiments gone wrong.

enemy.name: Witch's Familiar (Carrion Bat)
enemy.weakness: Incendiary Flask (obtained from this encounter)

encounters.hazard: The air is thick with a sickly green mist that causes hallucinations and disorientation.

pickup.name: Incendiary Flask
pickup.effect: Increases fire damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: The bat scatters a vial of green mist. As the fog dissipates, the player finds the vial and a glowing flask on the desk.

enemy.name: Alchemical Wraith
enemy.weakness: Incendiary Flask (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The walls are covered in strange alchemical symbols that pulse with energy and cause brief paralysis if touched.

pickup.name: Soul Vial
pickup.effect: Grants temporary invulnerability for 3 seconds on use

encounters.trigger: The Wraith emerges from a glowing sigil on the wall. After defeating it, a hidden chamber is revealed with a vial marked with the same alchemical sigil as the symbols on the walls.

enemy.name: The Alchemist's Shadow
enemy.weakness: Soul Vial (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The shadows in the chamber move independently, forming clawed hands that attack the player.

pickup.name: Alchemical Catalyst
pickup.effect: Allows the player to use the Alchemical Catalyst to target the boss's crystalline core

encounters.trigger: As the player defeats the Shadow, the ground cracks open, revealing the crystalline core of the Hollow Alchemist. The player collects the catalyst, which begins to pulse in rhythm with the core.

boss.name: The Hollow Alchemist
boss.weakness: Alchemical Catalyst (obtained from the final encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the crystalline core in its chest with the Alchemical Catalyst.

level.objective: Navigate through the corrupted alchemical ruins, defeat the twisted manifestations of the lost art, and confront the Hollow Alchemist to restore balance to the arcane forces.
level.reward: A sealed tome of lost alchemical formulas, granting permanent ability to craft rare potions.

level.theme: Ominous and foreboding, with an ever-present sense of dread and the possibility of death at every turn
level.setting: A desolate, ancient temple buried beneath a scorched wasteland, with flickering shadows and whispers echoing through the halls

enemy.name: Ashbound Wraith
enemy.weakness: Firebolt

encounters.hazard: Cursed Flame Pits

pickup.name: Ember Core
pickup.effect: Unlock 'Firebolt' ability

encounters.trigger: Destroy the cursed flame pits to unlock the path to the next encounter

enemy.name: Infernal Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Ember Core

encounters.hazard: Collapsing Stone Columns

pickup.name: Flameheart
pickup.effect: Grants temporary fire resistance

encounters.trigger: Trigger the collapsing stone columns to reveal the final path to the boss

enemy.name: The Flameless Warden
enemy.weakness: Eternal Ember

encounters.hazard: Sealed Chamber with Molten Locks

pickup.name: Eternal Ember
pickup.effect: Grants 'Eternal Ember' artifact

encounters.trigger: Break the molten locks using the Flameheart to proceed to the boss

boss.name: The Flameless Warden
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Flameless Warden with the 'Eternal Ember' artifact

level.objective: Survive the cursed ruins and defeat the Flameless Warden using the artifacts and abilities you have acquired
level.reward: Eternal Ember artifact and access to the next zone

level.theme: A descent into madness where reality and illusion blur, testing the player's perception and reflexes.
level.setting: A forgotten temple in a cursed forest, filled with eerie echoes and twisted remnants of old magic.

enemy.name: Cursed Watcher
enemy.weakness: Shadow Dagger (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and low visibility

pickup.name: Light Lens
pickup.effect: Unlocks a powerful light vision mode when equipped

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Cursed Watcher reveals a hidden passage leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Spectral Warden
enemy.weakness: Light Lens (from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Echoing whispers and ghostly illusions

pickup.name: Ancient Stone
pickup.effect: Increases player stamina by 20%

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Warden's illusion triggers a hidden switch, revealing the final chamber.

enemy.name: Shadow Revenant
enemy.weakness: Shadow Dagger (player's weapon)

encounters.hazard: Darkness and shifting shadows

pickup.name: Truth Mirror
pickup.effect: Allows the player to see through the boss's illusions

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Revenant opens a sealed door, revealing the boss: The Hollow Watcher.

boss.name: The Hollow Watcher
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core of the Watcher's eye using the Light Lens from the first encounter.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the corrupted temple and destroy the Hollow Watcher.
level.reward: Master of the Shadows: Unlocks a unique stealth ability for future levels.

level.theme: Desolation and decay, with whispers of a forgotten past and the slow unraveling of the world around the player.
level.setting: A long-abandoned ranger outpost surrounded by twisted forests and crumbling ruins, filled with the echoes of lost souls.
level.player_weapon: Ranger's Longbow (100% damage boost against the first encounter)

enemy.name: Shadow Wisp
enemy.weakness: The player's bow

encounters.hazard: The ground cracks open, revealing a glowing pool of corrupted water that inflicts damage over time.

pickup.name: Aether Lens
pickup.effect: Increases ranged damage by 15% for 30 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Wisp vanishes, revealing a hidden path leading to the next area.

enemy.name: Corrupted Huntress
enemy.weakness: Aether Lens (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The air grows thick with mist, reducing visibility and increasing enemy accuracy.

pickup.name: Ghost Echo
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden paths and weak points in the environment

encounters.trigger: The Huntress collapses, revealing a hidden passage beneath the grove leading to the boss arena.

enemy.name: Carrion Stalker
enemy.weakness: Ghost Echo (from prior encounter)

encounters.hazard: The ground is littered with traps that trigger when the player moves too quickly, causing damage and slowing progress.

pickup.name: Key of the Warden
pickup.effect: Unlocks the final path to the boss

encounters.trigger: The Stalker retreats, allowing the player to pass through the final gate to the boss fight.

boss.name: The Withered Watcher
boss.weakness: Aether Lens (obtained from the second encounter)

level.objective: Survive the haunted ruins, uncover the truth behind the corrupted spirits, and defeat The Withered Watcher.
level.reward: Aetheric Bow - permanent damage boost and ability to see spectral enemies.

level.theme: Mysterious and foreboding, with a slow build-up of tension. Each encounter reveals more about the crypt's cursed past and the reason the Warden was awakened.
level.setting: A dark, decaying crypt filled with ancient grave markers, flickering torches, and unsettling whispers in the wind. The air feels heavy with the presence of the dead.

enemy.name: Cursed Spectre
enemy.weakness: The Cursed Spectre is vulnerable to fire. The player’s 'Infernal Staff' can deal bonus damage.

encounters.hazard: The ground cracks open, revealing a hidden chamber where the first enemy appears.

pickup.name: Infernal Staff
pickup.effect: Increases magic damage by 20%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Cursed Spectre, the crypt doors slowly creak open, revealing a dark passage.

enemy.name: Bound Wraith
enemy.weakness: The Bound Wraith is weak to sound. The 'Soul Lantern' can disorient it and allow the player to strike for extra damage.

encounters.hazard: The walls pulse with an eerie glow, and a chain-bound wraith materializes from the shadows.

pickup.name: Soul Lantern
pickup.effect: Unlocks a special attack that deals damage over time to multiple enemies

encounters.trigger: The Bound Wraith’s attack triggers a hidden lever, which unlocks the next chamber leading to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Corrupted Guardian
enemy.weakness: The Corrupted Guardian is resistant to most attacks, but its armor is damaged by the 'Soul Lantern' light, exposing its core.

encounters.hazard: A massive corrupted guardian rises from the floor, blocking the path to the final chamber.

pickup.name: Elixir of the Necromancer
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of the player's health and mana

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Corrupted Guardian, the room collapses, revealing the hidden chamber where The Forgotten Warden awaits.

boss.name: The Forgotten Warden
boss.weakness: The Forgotten Warden is vulnerable to light. Only the 'Soul Lantern' can harm it directly.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Warden by exploiting its vulnerability to the 'Soul Lantern' item acquired from the third encounter.

level.objective: Reach the core of the crypt and defeat the Forgotten Warden, the guardian of the dead. Collect key pickups and use them strategically to overcome each challenge.
level.reward: Access to the 'Sanctum of the Dead' – a powerful new area with new abilities and loot

level.theme: The deeper the player goes, the more unstable the world becomes – reality fractures, and sanity erodes.
level.setting: A decaying, cursed temple in a forgotten village, filled with bloodstained corridors, echoing screams, and unstable environments
level.player_weapon: Blade of Chaos (starting weapon, becomes weaker with each encounter)

enemy.name: Flesh Harrier
enemy.weakness: Blade of Chaos (player's starting weapon)

encounters.hazard: Collapsing ceiling fragments

pickup.name: Blade of Chaos
pickup.effect: Blade of Chaos deals double damage to flesh-based enemies

encounters.trigger: Player enters the chapel and activates the altar, causing the Harrier to spawn.

enemy.name: Vile Warden
enemy.weakness: Soulbrand (obtained in encounter 3)

encounters.hazard: Explosive gas pockets

pickup.name: Flame Core
pickup.effect: Ignites nearby enemies on hit

encounters.trigger: Player ignites the Flame Core, causing the Warden to emerge from the shadows.

enemy.name: Soulbound Reaver
enemy.weakness: Soulbrand (obtained from a hidden altar)

encounters.hazard: Corrupted blood mist (reduces player stamina)

pickup.name: Soulbrand
pickup.effect: Grants access to 'Soulbrand' – a weapon that severs spiritual essence

encounters.trigger: Player defeats the Reaver, triggering a vision that leads to the boss chamber.

boss.name: The Butcher of Hollow Vein
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the 'Soulbrand' weapon.

level.objective: Survive the chaos and slay the Butcher of Hollow Vein using the 'Soulbrand' weapon, acquired during the final encounter.
level.reward: Soulforged Armor – grants resistance to all elemental and spiritual damage

level.theme: Serene horror: beauty and silence hide the presence of ancient, corrupted entities.
level.setting: An abandoned sanctuary where nature and decay have merged, creating a peaceful yet unsettling atmosphere.
level.player_weapon: Warden's Baton (light melee, can be upgraded with pickups)

enemy.name: Shattered Sentinel
enemy.weakness: The player's starting weapon (Warden's Baton)

encounters.hazard: Frostbloom (slow, reduces movement speed by 30%)

pickup.name: Echo of the Ancients
pickup.effect: Restores 50% of player's health

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shattered Sentinel, the Frostbloom clears, revealing a path forward.

enemy.name: Wraithbound Warden
enemy.weakness: Echo of the Ancients (restores health, but also emits a pulse that weakens the Wraithbound)

encounters.hazard: Luminescent Veil (causes temporary blindness when passing through)

pickup.name: Resonant Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks the Resonant Key

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wraithbound Warden, the Luminescent Veil fades, revealing the Resonant Key at the altar.

enemy.name: The Hollow Warden
enemy.weakness: Resonant Key (direct damage when used during its vulnerable state)

encounters.hazard: Phantom Tendrils (pulls the player toward the center of the arena)

pickup.name: Resonant Surge
pickup.effect: Unlocks a new weapon ability (Resonant Surge)

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Hollow Warden, the tendril pull ceases, and the Resonant Surge ability is unlocked.

boss.name: The Hollow Warden
boss.weakness: Resonant Key (obtained from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Hollow Warden by exploiting the Resonant Key

level.objective: Defeat the Hollow Warden, a corrupted former guardian of this place, by progressing through three encounters that gradually reveal the key to its downfall.
level.reward: Resonant Surge ability and the Resonant Key, granting the player a new level of power and control over the environment.

level.theme: A whimsical horror level where the danger comes not from fear, but from confusion and self-doubt.
level.setting: A whimsical, surreal castle where reality is malleable and dreams come alive. Everything here is slightly off-kilter, and the player must trust their own perception to survive.
level.player_weapon: Illusion Wand (can create light, mirrors, and distractions)

enemy.name: Shadow Mimic
enemy.weakness: The Shadow Mimic is vulnerable to light, specifically the 'Lumen Lens' item found in the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: The floor is covered in a black, sticky substance that makes the player's footsteps echo. This attracts the Mimic.

pickup.name: Lumen Lens
pickup.effect: The Lumen Lens allows the player to see through illusions and reveal the true form of enemies.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Shadow Mimic, the floor cracks open, revealing a hidden passage leading to the next encounter.

enemy.name: Whispering Doppelgänger
enemy.weakness: The Doppelgänger is vulnerable to the Lumen Lens, which disrupts its mirror-based illusions.

encounters.hazard: The room is filled with mirrors that whisper the player's doubts. Each mirror reflects a different version of the player, causing confusion.

pickup.name: Thread of Reality
pickup.effect: A small, glowing thread found in the chest of the Doppelgänger. It is tied to the Puppeteer's Heart.

encounters.trigger: After breaking the Doppelgänger’s illusion with the Lumen Lens, the mirrors shatter, revealing a hidden door that leads to the final encounter.

enemy.name: The Wailing Puppeteer
enemy.weakness: The Puppeteer is vulnerable to the 'Thread of Reality' item acquired in the previous encounter.

encounters.hazard: The final chamber is a dream-like void filled with floating, broken puppets that scream when touched. The room is unstable and shifts in response to the player's emotions.

pickup.name: Vision of Self
pickup.effect: Defeating the Puppeteer grants the player a vision of their own potential, temporarily increasing illusion creation ability.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wailing Puppeteer with the 'Thread of Reality,' the dream void collapses, and the player is transported to the game's next chapter.

boss.name: The Wailing Puppeteer
boss.weakness: The Puppeteer is vulnerable to the 'Thread of Reality' item, which can unravel his illusions and reveal his true form.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the Puppeteer’s Heart with the 'Thread of Reality' item acquired from the final encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the three enchanted rooms, uncover the true nature of the illusions, and defeat the Wailing Puppeteer using the items acquired along the way.
level.reward: A pocket full of glowing dust that can be used to create custom illusions for future encounters.

level.setting: A derelict steampunk facility filled with leaking steam, broken automata, and malfunctioning machines. The air is thick with smoke and the clanging of metal echoes through the halls.

enemy.name: Steam Wraith
enemy.weakness: Tesla Coils (player weapon)

encounters.hazard: Explosive Steam Pots

pickup.name: Battery Core
pickup.effect: Restores 100 health and increases Tesla Coil damage by 15%

encounters.trigger: Destroy the steam wraith to activate a pressure plate, opening the path to the next room.

enemy.name: Clockwork Soldier
enemy.weakness: Battery Core (pickup from first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Laser Tripwires

pickup.name: Tachyon Resonator
pickup.effect: Increases player's shield capacity by 20%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the Clockwork Soldier to unlock the Gears of Time, which powers the final boss.

enemy.name: The Iron Warden's Prototype
enemy.weakness: Tachyon Resonator (pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Expanding Steam Vortex

pickup.name: Gears of Time
pickup.effect: Gives access to the Gears of Time, which can be used to damage the boss

encounters.trigger: Destroy the prototype to activate the Gears of Time and unlock the final boss fight.

boss.name: The Iron Warden
boss.weakness: The Gears of Time (acquired in the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central core with the Gears of Time

level.objective: Navigate the chaotic steampunk facility, defeat three enemies, acquire key pickups, and destroy the Iron Warden using the Gears of Time.
level.reward: Blueprints for a Gears of Time Weapon

level.theme: Mysterious, atmospheric, and mechanically intricate. The level is filled with hidden mechanisms, arcane machinery, and eerie, ghost-like automatons.
level.setting: A forgotten steampunk metropolis, riddled with mechanical guardians and ancient technology. The air is thick with steam and mystery, and the very city seems to be alive and watching you.

enemy.name: Golem-Screecher
enemy.weakness: The player's primary weapon (Steamfire Cannon)

encounters.hazard: A shifting mechanical maze with collapsing platforms and steam vents

pickup.name: Echo Lens
pickup.effect: Reveals hidden paths and disables enemy targeting for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem-Screecher unlocks the hidden elevator to the next area

enemy.name: Steam Wraith
enemy.weakness: The Echo Lens (from the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: A flooded chamber with active steam vents that can erupt randomly

pickup.name: Steamheart Crucible
pickup.effect: Replenishes 50% of the player's mana and grants a temporary shield against steam damage

encounters.trigger: After surviving the Steam Wraith, the Steamheart Crucible activates a hidden pressure plate, opening the gate to the final encounter

enemy.name: Ironclad Automaton
enemy.weakness: The Steamheart Crucible (from the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: A collapsing arena with moving platforms and arcane energy traps

pickup.name: Chrono Core Capacitor
pickup.effect: Grants the Chrono Core Capacitor, a device that can overload and destroy the Clockwork Sentinel’s core

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Ironclad Automaton unlocks the path to the Clockwork Sentinel and activates the final sequence

boss.name: The Clockwork Sentinel
boss.weakness: The Chrono Core Capacitor (obtained from the third encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the central clockwork core using the Chrono Core Capacitor

level.objective: Navigate through the ancient steampunk city of Nocturne, uncover its secrets, and destroy the Clockwork Sentinel.
level.reward: Unlocks the 'Chrono Artificer' title and grants permanent mana regeneration and increased weapon damage against mechanical enemies

level.theme: A whimsical journey through mechanical wonder, where the player must use clever alchemy to overcome the challenges of the clockwork world.
level.setting: A whimsical steampunk city filled with brass automatons, glowing gas lamps, and flying airships, all hidden beneath a grand clockwork cathedral.
level.player_weapon: Alchemical Flask Set (contains: Acid Flask, Smoke Flask, Glimmering Lens)

enemy.name: Steam Golem
enemy.weakness: Corrosive Gas (can be applied with the Acid Flask from the player's inventory)

encounters.hazard: Steam vents burst with hot gas.

pickup.name: Acid Flask
pickup.effect: Acid Flask (apply corrosive damage to enemies)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Steam Golem, the steam vents stop, revealing a hidden passage to the next area.

enemy.name: Clockwork Rook
enemy.weakness: Gears (can be damaged with the Glimmering Lens)

encounters.hazard: Clockwork traps activate, releasing gears across the floor.

pickup.name: Glimmering Lens
pickup.effect: Glimmering Lens (reveals weaknesses and weak spots on enemies)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Clockwork Rook, the gears lock into place, revealing a hidden door to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Ironclad Mole
enemy.weakness: Eyes (can be damaged with the Glimmering Lens)

encounters.hazard: The ground shakes as the mole burrows through the floor.

pickup.name: Tin Can
pickup.effect: Tin Can (allows the player to create a temporary smoke screen for stealth)

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Ironclad Mole, a glowing core is revealed in the final chamber, indicating the presence of the Clockwork Cyclops.

boss.name: Clockwork Cyclops
boss.weakness: Exposed Core (can only be damaged with the Glimmering Lens)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Clockwork Cyclops by targeting its exposed core with the Glimmering Lens from the third encounter.

level.objective: Navigate the steampunk labyrinth, defeat the three enemies, and use the Glimmering Lens to defeat the Clockwork Cyclops.
level.reward: A pocketwatch that tells the player's current time in the steampunk world.

level.theme: Brutal, tense, and mechanical. The environment is unforgiving, and every mistake leads to immediate consequences.
level.setting: A sprawling steampunk factory filled with gears, steam pipes, and mechanical enemies. The air is thick with smoke, and the sound of grinding metal fills the atmosphere.

enemy.name: Clockwork Sentinel
enemy.weakness: The Clockwork Sentinel is weak to piercing attacks. The player's primary weapon, the 'Razorwind Dagger,' is a piercing weapon.

encounters.hazard: Steam vents erupt intermittently, forcing the player to dodge or risk taking damage.

pickup.name: Steam Capacitor (Inactive)
pickup.effect: Unlock a new ability: 'Steam Burst,' which deals area damage and stuns enemies briefly.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Clockwork Sentinel, the Steam Capacitor becomes active and powers up the next encounter.

enemy.name: Tinclad Enforcer
enemy.weakness: The Tinclad Enforcer is weak to fire damage. A fire bomb found in the previous area can be used to exploit this weakness.

encounters.hazard: Falling debris from collapsed beams blocks the path, requiring the player to use the 'Steam Burst' ability to clear the way.

pickup.name: Furnace Igniter
pickup.effect: Obtain a fire bomb called the 'Furnace Igniter.'

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Tinclad Enforcer, the fire bomb triggers a hidden steam valve, releasing a burst of pressure that opens the path to the final encounter.

enemy.name: Gearmaster
enemy.weakness: The Gearmaster is weak to electric attacks. The 'Steam Capacitor,' which was powered by the previous encounter, is now fully charged and can be used as a weapon.

encounters.hazard: A collapsing ceiling forces the player to move quickly or take damage.

pickup.name: Steam Capacitor (Active)
pickup.effect: Charge the 'Steam Capacitor' to its full potential, making it a powerful electric weapon.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Gearmaster, the charged Steam Capacitor activates the final door, revealing the Iron Warden.

boss.name: The Iron Warden
boss.weakness: The Iron Warden is vulnerable to electric damage. This weakness is only activated when the player has acquired the 'Steam Capacitor' from the third encounter.
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Iron Warden by exploiting the weakness revealed through prior encounters.

level.objective: Steal the prototype of the Iron Warden's core and escape the factory without being detected.
level.reward: Prototype Core (can be used to upgrade player abilities or unlock new paths in later levels)

level.setting: A ruined steampunk city, filled with rusted gears, glowing aether conduits, and storm-charged air.

enemy.name: Gearsoul Harbinger
enemy.weakness: Aether Core (obtained in this encounter).

encounters.hazard: Static Field (reduces player movement speed by 50% for 5 seconds)

pickup.name: Aether Core
pickup.effect: Increases storm damage by 25%

encounters.trigger: The static field is disrupted, revealing a hidden path to the next area.

enemy.name: Clockwork Warden
enemy.weakness: Stormbrand Gauntlet (must be used to bypass shield)

encounters.hazard: Steam Vent (deals 30 damage per second for 3 seconds if player stands in it)

pickup.name: Stormbrand Gauntlet
pickup.effect: Unlocks the ability to use Stormbrand Gauntlet

encounters.trigger: The Warden’s shield cracks, revealing a glowing path to the final chamber.

enemy.name: Clockwork Revenant
enemy.weakness: Stormbrand Gauntlet (must be fully charged with Aether Core energy)

encounters.hazard: Falling debris (randomly spawns and deals 40 damage if hit)

pickup.name: Stormward Cloak
pickup.effect: Grants temporary immunity to lightning damage

encounters.trigger: The Revenant is destroyed, triggering a surge of energy that unlocks the path to the boss.

boss.name: The Iron Tempest
boss.weakness: Stormbrand Gauntlet (must be equipped for damage to be effective).
boss.victory_condition: Deal 1000 damage to the boss with the Stormbrand Gauntlet (obtained in the third encounter).

level.objective: Defeat the Iron Tempest by channeling the Stormbrand Gauntlet with energy from the Aether Core, while navigating hazards and defeating three powerful encounters.
level.reward: Stormbrand Gauntlet (permanent upgrade to player's weapon)

level.setting: A crumbling steampunk city in the wake of a failed time experiment, where time fractures and machinery runs on unstable power sources.
level.player_weapon: Temporal Dagger - Can slow time for 5 seconds, allowing for critical strikes.

enemy.name: Golem Watcher
enemy.weakness: The player's time-slowing ability (triggered by the Chrono Wristlet)

encounters.hazard: Steam vents spew out time-disorienting clouds that cause the player to move in reverse for 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Chrono Wristlet
pickup.effect: Chrono Wristlet - Enables time-slowing for 5 seconds.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Golem Watcher unlocks the clocktower's upper elevator, which leads to the second encounter.

enemy.name: Mechanical Hourglass
enemy.weakness: The Chrono Wristlet (from the first encounter)

encounters.hazard: Time loops force the player to repeat the last 10 seconds of movement, unless the Chrono Wristlet is active.

pickup.name: Chrono Key
pickup.effect: Chrono Key - Unlocks the temporal core of the boss.

encounters.trigger: Destroying the Mechanical Hourglass activates a hidden path to the Chronosurge's chamber.

enemy.name: Chronosurge
enemy.weakness: The Chrono Key (from the second encounter)

encounters.hazard: Time distortions cause the environment to shift, making the player lose track of their position.

pickup.name: Chrono Core Fragment
pickup.effect: Chrono Core Fragment - Enhances the player's time manipulation abilities.

encounters.trigger: Defeating the Chronosurge unlocks a safe passage to the next level, with the Chrono Core Fragment as a reward.

boss.name: Chronosurge
boss.weakness: The Chrono Key (a pickup from the second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the temporal core by activating the time anchor with the Chrono Key.

level.objective: Navigate through the desolate steampunk ruins, recover time-based artifacts, and defeat the Chronosurge by using the Chrono Key.

level.theme: Eerie, oppressive, and filled with mechanical menace. The level is a testament to a bygone era of invention, now corrupted and dangerous.
level.setting: A forgotten steampunk city, overgrown with rust and decay. The air is thick with steam and the distant sounds of broken machinery echo through the halls.
level.player_weapon: Seismic Staff with elemental surge ability

encounters.location: The first chamber of the derelict clock tower. The air is thick with dust and the scent of oil and decay. Mechanical gears groan in the distance.

enemy.name: Clockwork Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Its brass armor is vulnerable to the geomancer's seismic shockwave ability. This ability will cause the Sentinel to fracture, revealing a hidden 'Celestial Lens' inside.

encounters.hazard: A collapsing stone archway will trigger a tremor that disrupts the player's balance if not avoided.

pickup.name: Celestial Lens
pickup.effect: The 'Celestial Lens' can be used to magnify geomantic energy and target weak points in enemies.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Clockwork Sentinel, the archway collapses, revealing a path to the next chamber.

encounters.location: A cavern filled with rusted machinery and skeletal remains of other geomancers. The walls are lined with glowing runes that pulse erratically.

enemy.name: Steamforged Wraith
enemy.weakness: The Wraith's energy core is disrupted by the geomancer's earth spike ability, which can be amplified by the 'Celestial Lens' from the first encounter.

encounters.hazard: A mist of toxic steam spreads across the chamber, reducing the player's movement speed and visibility.

pickup.name: Resonance Crystal
pickup.effect: The 'Resonance Crystal' amplifies the geomancer’s seismic abilities by 30% for 60 seconds.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Wraith, the runes on the wall activate, forming a gate that leads to the final chamber.

encounters.location: The final chamber is a cathedral of brass and stone. At its center stands the Hollow Warden, surrounded by flickering lanterns and a swirling vortex of dark steam.

enemy.name: The Hollow Warden
enemy.weakness: As previously described. The 'Celestial Lens' must be used with the 'Resonance Crystal' to create a powerful geomantic burst that pierces the core.

encounters.hazard: The chamber is filled with floating debris and unstable platforms. The floor occasionally collapses, creating hazards.

pickup.name: Empyrean Mantle
pickup.effect: Upon defeating the boss, the player gains the 'Empyrean Mantle,' which grants 100% damage resistance for 10 seconds.

encounters.trigger: The Hollow Warden awakens upon the player's entry and begins its assault.

boss.name: The Hollow Warden
boss.weakness: The Hollow Warden's core crystal is vulnerable to the 'Celestial Lens' obtained in the first encounter. The lens must be used in conjunction with a geomantic resonance to overload the core.
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the core crystal in its chest using the 'Celestial Lens' item

level.objective: Navigate the derelict clock tower, defeat three mechanical enemies, and finally vanquish the Hollow Warden using the items collected in prior encounters.
level.reward: Empyrean Mantle, Celestial Lens, Resonance Crystal, and access to the next level of the steampunk world.

level.theme: Serene steampunk exploration with mechanical enemies and subtle hazards.
level.setting: A vast, steampunk cathedral powered by massive gears and glowing pipes, with soft ambient lighting and the distant hum of machinery.
level.player_weapon: Light Brand (initial form, deals 4 damage to metal enemies).

encounters.location: The Iron Sanctum - Hall of Gears

enemy.name: Steam Golem
enemy.weakness: Paladin's Light Brand

encounters.hazard: A loose gear falls from above, dealing 2 damage.

pickup.name: Light Brand
pickup.effect: Light Brand (weapon upgrade for your hammer, increases damage by 2 against metal enemies).

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the Steam Golem, a hidden panel activates, revealing a hidden passage.

encounters.location: The Iron Sanctum - Chamber of Echoes

enemy.name: Clockwork Sentinel
enemy.weakness: Mechanic's Gear

encounters.hazard: A steam explosion damages the player for 3 damage.

pickup.name: Mechanic's Gear
pickup.effect: Mechanic's Gear (a small cog that disrupts mechanical enemies when used).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Clockwork Sentinel, a distant chime signals the approach of the final guardian.

encounters.location: The Iron Sanctum - Antechamber of Light

enemy.name: Steam Warden
enemy.weakness: Light Brand

encounters.hazard: A steam vent releases a cloud of fog that obscures vision for 3 seconds.

pickup.name: Reinforced Light Brand
pickup.effect: Light Brand (reinforced, increases damage by 3 against metal enemies).

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Steam Warden, the final chamber opens, revealing the Clockwork Archon.

boss.name: The Clockwork Archon
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the Clockwork Archon using the Mechanic's Gear obtained from the prior encounters.

level.objective: Reach the heart of the Iron Sanctum and defeat the Clockwork Archon.
level.reward: A glowing cog that enhances the player's abilities in future levels, along with a small chest of steam-powered relics.
